remarks: Here's a Lake Ontario waterfront retreat with 103 feet of fully erosion-controlled shoreline and a perfect view of the Toronto skyline... what could be better? From the minute you walk in the front door, you see the lake from this expanded Cape Cod style home. Set amid gardens and trees, the property is perfect for entertaining and comfortable living. Enjoy morning sunrises and spectacular sunsets from this three-bedroom, three full bath home featuring three enclosed porches. With vaulted ceilings on the open-concept main level, your comfort is assured. There's also a primary suite on the first floor and another on the second level. The kitchen boasts plenty of hardwood cabinets with granite countertops and the appliances are included. For your convenience, there is a first-floor laundry. The heated three-car detached garage has a work area, 50 and 30 amp services, and a 30 amp RV pad for your boat or motorhome. There is also a spacious shed. The house has an on-demand water heater and a propane fired boiler. The garage has its own propane tank. The grounds have been lovingly planted with perennials. For your recreation, there's also a Kayak pool with a new liner.
